### God-Moving Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-moving-prayer
Passage: Genesis 18:26
Points:
- Abraham's intercession for Sodom highlights how God invites and responds to the prayers of His people.
- God’s eternal decrees cannot be changed, yet this truth does not make prayer pointless or fatalistic.
- Scripture reveals that God uses our intercessory prayers as the means through which He fulfills His will.
- Believers can boldly bring requests to God, knowing He genuinely interacts with us and responds according to His purposes.

### Abraham’s Persistent Prayer
Author: Michael A. Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-july-6-2025.html
Passage: Genesis 18:32
Points:
- Many Christians struggle with persistence in prayer and give up too quickly when answers are delayed.
- Abraham recognized he was approaching the Creator with humility, asking progressively for greater mercy.
- God never grew annoyed or weary with Abraham's repeated appeals, but actively welcomed his boldness.
- Believers are called to persist in faithful prayer for their families, communities, and nations.
